sourceText: M4 (final milestone): analyze-batch.mjs — an offline analyzer reading batch-ledger.jsonl (H1/H4), tamper-verdicts.jsonl (H2), resume-reconciliation.json (H3) + protocol.json, emitting a three-state (pass|fail|inconclusive) H1-H4 report.json/.md with a reproducible digest; Codex cross-host replicates the report digest.
normalizedOutcome: node analyze-batch.mjs writes report.json + report.md with per-hypothesis three-state verdicts + a reproducible sha256 digest; node selfcheck-m4.mjs prints 'selfcheck-m4 PASS'; a second host re-derives the identical digest offline.
acceptanceClaim: The campaign has a single reproducible H1-H4 adjudication report whose digest a second host replicates byte-for-byte from the same committed evidence, and whose three-state logic provably never turns missing/tampered evidence into a false pass.
